target: Tomb Raider (2013), 2800x1752 Low, 60 Hz, Samsung Galaxy Tab S8+ SM-X808U
diagnosis: Allocating sixteen repetitions for every previously unseen signature consumed finite real pool descriptors on cold signatures. The later exact retry could not recover the unused speculative capacity.
next_gate: E133 starts each signature at two repetitions, doubles only after a fully drained bank proves demand, removes reset-time prefill, and preserves exact fallback and reset/destroy invalidation.
reuse: The required E132 and E133 deja queries returned no indexed implementation. Runtime validation reused E131's paired-ADB Activity handoff, ANR-Wait watchdog, screenshot inspection, first-rejection diagnostic, and protected-process checks.
